reason: The manuscript table reports a paired-block percentile bootstrap interval for every primary representation. The frozen implementation had inadvertently omitted the moment-registration comparator from that descriptive interval while including the other three methods.
replacement: At nuisance seed 20260731 and for the primary pair only, moment registration now receives the same 10000 paired-block bootstrap resamples as the quotient, raw-coordinate, and finite-Euler representations. Exact randomization p-values remain the primary inferential quantities and are unchanged by this amendment.
outcome_access_statement: This amendment was made after the independent simulation completed but before the held-out RxRx1 image analysis began. No RxRx1 outcome statistic, p-value, confidence interval, replication result, or robustness result had been computed or inspected.
